reviews.t: I use a lingerie bag to wash them.
reviews.x: After reading several reviews stating the buttons fall off, I decided to use a lingerie bag to wash the headbands, and I have not had a problem after over a month of use.  I love the variety of colors, and I appreciate that they save my ears, because before wearing headbands on a regular basis I was getting scabs behind my ears due to wearing a mask all day.

Description says it won’t slip. Every time I move it winds up on top of my head (with my bun in the middle) like a tiara. Even worse is I don’t feel it slip so I’m walking around for god knows how long looking like an idiot.

These are the most stretchable & comfortable. My head size is larger & my hair thick, so these are almost the best. They are also thinner & cooler. However,  the fabric color looks much lighter when stretched & the buttons are a little smaller than I prefer. But what I took 1 star off for was the fact that the buttons are too far back on the band, which makes the mask way too tight on my face. Also, if you have a small, petite head with flat hair, you might find that these do not stay in place l

The amount and quality is great for the price. My complaints are: the colors are not as vibrant as depicted and there doesn't seem to be much difference in the pattern and color of all the headbands. I gave two away just because they looked like duplicates. Also, the buttons only secure flimsy surgical mask ear loops. If I try to wear one of my own masks with thicker ear loops, they don't stay put.

reviews.t: Cute - & saves from mask related dermatitis!!!
reviews.x: Bought these to wear at work in the hospital. The mask loops cause the skin behind my ears to peel & weep, so these buttons are perfect!!! I’ve gotten so many compliments since the vibrant colors match our navy blue scrubs! I keep a few extra in my purse just in case I forget. Only downside, the fabric tends to dry out my hair in front & in the future I’d love to purchase some that are satin-lined. But these are still a great buy, less drying than cotton, keep my skin intact & keep me stylish wh

reviews.t: Beautiful and comfortable and effective! Just what I needed
reviews.x: These are beautiful and comfortable. All are slightly different and somehow all of them seem to go with whatever I’m wearing, even though I typically hate pinks and purples and wear mostly goth or alternative style... this has helped my ears so much, as a glasses wearer I’m constantly getting headaches from the mask and glasses combined.  *You might have to adjust the mask straps if you need a super tight fit for medical work*  *silky, satin, shiny fabric*  *very comfy for a bigger size head ;)

reviews.t: Wanted for pain relief, did not get it.
reviews.x: So these don't work great, honestly they kept slipping off my head and they get turned around so easily I kept losing where the buttons where on the sides. The buttons also ended up being right behind my ears most of the time and wasn't really helpful in keeping my mask strings off my ears. They work good for like 10 maybe 15 mins before everything goes to heck in a handbasket and you are tugging it back into place.

I like that these are a nice thin fabric and still has vibrant color. I didn't have a problem with the button placement like some stated. Wore them for 12 hour shifts. My only problem is they are not non-slip. They didn't come off, but moved around enough that the hair tucked under around my temples and ears would bunch out. I have thin-ish shoulder length hair.
I have a big head. I do not know my hat size, but this headband is okay. The buttons are too small to consistently keep a facemask off the ears. Manufacturer should use larger buttons.
This is nothing more than a stretchy piece of fabric to wear on your head. It doesn't hold the masks at all. The buttons are flimsy at best, stay away from this one.

reviews.t: Not bad but could be better
reviews.x: It’s a little big for my head. I would have preferred the buttons be placed further back for a better fit and less pressure on my ears when I wear my mask.

reviews.t: Feels cheap, buttons small, basically all the same color.
reviews.x: The material is pretty slippery, as other reviewers said. The colors aren’t as represented, but generally blue, so don’t think you’re getting an assortment of colors. The buttons are set far back on the band, and tiny, so it’s easy for the mask elastic to slip off. They will probably serve their purpose, but I might have to find larger buttons to replace these, and just sew them centered above the ears. I thought they would be softer, but they aren’t super soft. I’ll have to test one out to see

I am a crazy sweater.  These are cute.  I like the patterns.  My mask kept slipping off of the buttons..  but that was probably operator error..  :/  the only thing that i see wrong us that the material is very thin and slick.  I know the discretion says ..silky..  but I was hoping they would absorb some of the sweat..  I work in a bakery and after an hour I had to take this one off and use one of my old ones..  these are good for light sweaters..  not heavy..  I am going to give them to my mom

I dislike that the buttons are in the back it does not show that on the products and I see that if you are deaf there is no where to put your cochlear implant. The headbands do work I test it out. But not with all my equipment on. So I been sewing little tuck pockets on headbands for the cochlear implant because I am a crafter but if you got no knowledge in sewing and you deaf go on etsy they have what I am talking about they cost more but if you don't know hand sewing that's the way to go.

I work in the ER and have to wear a mask my entire 12 hour shift. About 3 hours into the shift, my ears start to hurt something terrible. Even causes headaches. These headbands have been PERFECT! They are super cute and comfortable. The buttons are in the perfect place and keep my mask snug and in place. They also keep my hair back and out of my face. (And off of patients lol)  I just got a new job as a manager and I plan to purchase for my staff as a welcome gift!

reviews.t: A more comfortable way to wear face masks!
reviews.x: These headbands are a perfect idea for my job. I’m a nurse and I have to wear mask 8-10 hours so they protected my ears from taking the pressure off their ears from the face mask. The headbands were stretchy which make them very easy to put on and the buttons were sewn snug to the headband. Plus they were very cute. suggest to reinforce the buttons carefully before wearing but very happy with this purchase.I will definitely buy these again!

I use them for work. I work in medical field and needed something to keep my hair back. These head bands do the trick. They fit snug, very comfortable and don’t slide off. Love it-love it-love it! Finally found the right head band. Got tired of spending money on all them other useless bands. Thank you for an amazing product!

I don't have a big head, I think I have a fairly average size head and these are a little tight. They also don't stay put very well and slide back unless I have my mask holding it in place. If they weren't so tight they would be way better. They fit my 9 year olds head pretty good though.

I have a big head and these work well (as well as being attractive.  I bought another brand and way too small for my head (children's sized) and these are fine to wear for 8-12 hour shifts and really takes the tension off my ears .  Patients have commented that they are cute.

I love love love everything about these headbands .... except the colors. I tried ordering ones I thought were similar to give me some more variety in colors/design but they are not the same. These are so comfy and I get compliments all the time.

reviews.t: Pretty good, if you have a small head.
reviews.x: I like the colors very much. There was nothing to keep them from staying on though... The were uncomfortable for me because they slipped off my head, due to the slick material. They'd be fine for smaller headed people, I guess.

So they’re comfortable, but don’t stay in place, they’re too loose. They also are too flimsy to hold the elastic from masks for long. It’s basically useless. I got them because I have hearing aids, glasses, and masks...

I love the colors. I don’t like the small buttons. They need to be larger. I am a nurse and wear a KN95 mask at work. The headbands were bought to attach straps around the buttons but it pulls and detaches easily.

reviews.t: Cute but not a good fit
reviews.x: I liked the designs but they fit very loose and the buttons are not place evenly for a face mask loops to fit right and loops don’t even stay on. The price is good for how many headbands you get but not worth it.

reviews.t: Slippery but they get the job done
reviews.x: The fabric is super slick so they don't stay put. I use Bobby pins to keep them in place. Other than that they're comfortable and soft. The patterns are nice and bold. For the price you really can't complain.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the headbands comfortable, cute, and effective at relieving ear pain from mask loops, especially for long shifts.
A common complaint is that the headbands slip or move around on the head rather than staying in place.
Reviewers frequently say the buttons are too small or flimsy, causing mask elastic to slip off.
Several reviewers note the colors are less vibrant or less varied than depicted, with many bands looking similar.
Some reviewers mention the fabric is thin and slick, which affects absorbency and grip.
